iconOverrides.description: SmartDock-only local PNG/SVG artwork by desktop ID. Prefer icons set/reset for single-app edits; no rendering verification is implied.

ui.label: App and profile icons
ui.help: SmartDock-only local PNG/SVG artwork by desktop ID. Prefer icons set/reset for single-app edits; no rendering verification is implied.

windowIconOverrides.description: Ordered per-window artwork rules keyed by normalized raw Wayland appId plus a case-insensitive titlePattern. Only * is a wildcard; first match wins. Sources must be local PNG/SVG files.

ui.label: Window-title rules
ui.help: Ordered per-window artwork rules keyed by normalized raw Wayland appId plus a case-insensitive titlePattern. Only * is a wildcard; first match wins. Sources must be local PNG/SVG files.

iconSize.description: Base application icon size in logical pixels.

ui.label: Icon size
ui.help: Base application icon size in logical pixels.

magnification.description: Hover icon scale; requested fractions are retained.

ui.label: Hover magnification
ui.help: Hover icon scale; requested fractions are retained.

magnificationRadius.description: Hover influence radius in logical pixels.

ui.label: Magnification reach
ui.help: Hover influence radius in logical pixels.

hoverGlowEnabled.description: Enable glow behind hovered application icons.

ui.label: Hover glow
ui.help: Enable glow behind hovered application icons.

ui.label: Glow strength
ui.help: Glow opacity. Requested 0.72 renders as 0.70.

hoverGlowRadius.description: Glow radius; active when hoverGlowEnabled is true.

ui.label: Glow radius
ui.help: Glow radius; active when hoverGlowEnabled is true.

ui.label: Window previews
ui.help: Allow grouped-window previews.

showTrash.description: Show Trash and enable its existing polling; does not empty Trash.

ui.label: Show Trash
ui.help: Show Trash and enable its existing polling; does not empty Trash.

margin.description: Edge margin; retained by preference reset.

ui.label: Edge margin
ui.help: Edge margin; retained by preference reset.

backgroundOpacity.description: Multiplier of the effective background color alpha.

ui.label: Background opacity
ui.help: Multiplier of the effective background color alpha.

backgroundColorEnabled.description: Enable the configured background color override.

ui.label: backgroundColor override
ui.help: Enable the configured background color override.
ui.reason: Changed by the paired primary control; never edited independently.

backgroundColor.description: Empty, #RRGGBB, Qt #AARRGGBB or @theme.token; active only with backgroundColorEnabled.

ui.label: Background color
ui.help: Empty, #RRGGBB, Qt #AARRGGBB or @theme.token; active only with backgroundColorEnabled.

borderColorEnabled.description: Enable the configured border color override.

ui.label: borderColor override
ui.help: Enable the configured border color override.
ui.reason: Changed by the paired primary control; never edited independently.

borderColor.description: Empty, #RRGGBB, Qt #AARRGGBB or @theme.token; active only with borderColorEnabled.

ui.label: Border color
ui.help: Empty, #RRGGBB, Qt #AARRGGBB or @theme.token; active only with borderColorEnabled.

workspaceBadgeBackgroundColorEnabled.description: Enable the workspace badge background override.

ui.label: workspaceBadgeBackgroundColor override
ui.help: Enable the workspace badge background override.
ui.reason: Changed by the paired primary control; never edited independently.

workspaceBadgeBackgroundColor.description: Empty, #RRGGBB, Qt #AARRGGBB or @theme.token; requires its paired Enabled flag.

ui.label: Badge background
ui.help: Empty, #RRGGBB, Qt #AARRGGBB or @theme.token; requires its paired Enabled flag.

workspaceBadgeTextColorEnabled.description: Enable the workspace badge text override.

ui.label: workspaceBadgeTextColor override
ui.help: Enable the workspace badge text override.
ui.reason: Changed by the paired primary control; never edited independently.

workspaceBadgeTextColor.description: Empty, #RRGGBB, Qt #AARRGGBB or @theme.token; requires its paired Enabled flag.

ui.label: Badge text color
ui.help: Empty, #RRGGBB, Qt #AARRGGBB or @theme.token; requires its paired Enabled flag.

borderWidthEnabled.description: Enable a fixed width instead of the theme's border widths.

ui.label: borderWidth override
ui.help: Enable a fixed width instead of the theme's border widths.
ui.reason: Changed by the paired primary control; never edited independently.

borderWidth.description: Fixed logical-pixel border width; theme-owned while borderWidthEnabled is false.

ui.label: Border width
ui.help: Fixed logical-pixel border width; theme-owned while borderWidthEnabled is false.

presentationMode.description: Classic bottom dock or mirrored sidebar panels (the dock's vertical presentation). Drag empty dock background left to switch to the sidebar, or empty sidebar background down to return.

ui.label: Other monitors
ui.help: Classic bottom dock or mirrored sidebar panels (the dock's vertical presentation). Drag empty dock background left to switch to the sidebar, or empty sidebar background down to return.

presentationModeByMonitor.description: Per-connector presentation overrides keyed by exact monitor connector with values classic or sidebar. A connector listed here ignores presentationMode and sidebarMonitor. Missing connectors follow the inherited mode. Disconnected names are retained; control characters and non-mode values are rejected.

ui.label: Monitor choice
ui.help: Per-connector presentation overrides keyed by exact monitor connector with values classic or sidebar. A connector listed here ignores presentationMode and sidebarMonitor. Missing connectors follow the inherited mode. Disconnected names are retained; control characters and non-mode values are rejected.

sidebarEdge.description: Sidebar panel edge; leaves classic position unchanged.

ui.label: Edge
ui.help: Sidebar panel edge; leaves classic position unchanged.

sidebarMonitor.description: Empty maps a mirrored panel on every connected screen. A connected connector maps only that output. Disconnected preferences are retained and fall back to all connected screens; control characters are rejected.

ui.label: Legacy banner
ui.help: Empty maps a mirrored panel on every connected screen. A connected connector maps only that output. Disconnected preferences are retained and fall back to all connected screens; control characters are rejected.
ui.reason: Legacy selection is converted by the one-click banner.

sidebarExpandedWidth.description: Requested expanded width in logical pixels. Runtime screen clamping never overwrites this preference.

ui.label: Width
ui.help: Requested expanded width in logical pixels. Runtime screen clamping never overwrites this preference.

sidebarWidgets.description: Ordered internal widget IDs. SmartDock registers herdr.agents and t3.threads; unknown imported IDs are retained but unavailable and explicit writes require registered IDs.

ui.label: Widgets list
ui.help: Ordered internal widget IDs. SmartDock registers herdr.agents and t3.threads; unknown imported IDs are retained but unavailable and explicit writes require registered IDs.

sidebarWidgetCollapsed.description: Per-widget collapsed body preferences keyed by valid internal widget ID. Missing keys mean expanded; removing a widget retains its preference.

ui.label: Not shown
ui.help: Per-widget collapsed body preferences keyed by valid internal widget ID. Missing keys mean expanded; removing a widget retains its preference.
ui.reason: Edited in place on each widget card.

sidebarCollapsed.description: Default icon rail for monitors without a sidebarCollapsedByMonitor override. Every eligible window remains represented; expanded width and session app folds are retained.

ui.label: Icon rail (other monitors)
ui.help: Default icon rail for monitors without a sidebarCollapsedByMonitor override. Every eligible window remains represented; expanded width and session app folds are retained.

sidebarCollapsedByMonitor.description: Per-connector sidebar collapse overrides. Missing connectors follow sidebarCollapsed. Disconnected names are retained; control characters and non-boolean values are rejected.

ui.label: Icon rail
ui.help: Per-connector sidebar collapse overrides. Missing connectors follow sidebarCollapsed. Disconnected names are retained; control characters and non-boolean values are rejected.

sidebarInlineSoloWorkspace.description: When true, populated workspace names share the first application/window row instead of emitting a separate workspace row. Empty workspaces remain dedicated rows.

ui.label: Compact workspace rows
ui.help: When true, populated workspace names share the first application/window row instead of emitting a separate workspace row. Empty workspaces remain dedicated rows.

sidebarBrowserTabsEnabled.description: When true and the browser-profile provider is available, sidebar Chrome window rows can expand to list open page tabs (titles only, no URLs). Independent of browserActivityMutedServices.

ui.label: Chrome tabs under windows
ui.help: When true and the browser-profile provider is available, sidebar Chrome window rows can expand to list open page tabs (titles only, no URLs). Independent of browserActivityMutedServices.

position.description: Classic dock edge; the classic dock renders on the bottom only and the left vertical presentation is the sidebar mode. Drag empty dock background left to switch to the sidebar. Legacy left, right and top read as bottom.

ui.label: No row of its own
ui.help: Classic dock edge; the classic dock renders on the bottom only and the left vertical presentation is the sidebar mode. Drag empty dock background left to switch to the sidebar. Legacy left, right and top read as bottom.
ui.reason: The classic dock is bottom-only; no Placement row.

fullLength.description: Extend the dock along its available screen edge.

ui.label: Full width
ui.help: The dock always sits on the bottom edge. Turn on to stretch it edge to edge.

reserveSpace.description: Reserve an exclusive zone; effective false while autoHide is enabled.

ui.label: Reserve screen space
ui.help: Reserve an exclusive zone; effective false while autoHide is enabled.

autoHide.description: Auto-hide the dock without changing the requested reserveSpace value.

ui.label: Auto-hide
ui.help: Auto-hide the dock without changing the requested reserveSpace value.

clickAction.description: Left-click action. close may close application windows when used.

ui.label: Left click
ui.help: Left-click action. close may close application windows when used.

middleClickAction.description: Middle-click action. New writes use canonical action names.

ui.label: Middle click
ui.help: Middle-click action. New writes use canonical action names.

scrollAction.description: Scroll behavior for applications with multiple windows.

ui.label: Scroll
ui.help: Scroll behavior for applications with multiple windows.

controlCommand.description: Launcher command executed only by the existing launcher action, never by validation or discovery.

ui.label: App launcher command
ui.help: Launcher command executed only by the existing launcher action, never by validation or discovery.

sortByWorkspace.description: Sort flat-layout applications by their lowest occupied workspace.

ui.label: Sort by workspace
ui.help: Sort flat-layout applications by their lowest occupied workspace.

workspaceLayout.description: Grouped cards are supported on top/bottom. Requested grouped survives a move to left/right.

ui.label: Arrange apps
ui.help: Grouped cards are supported on top/bottom. Requested grouped survives a move to left/right.

workspaceMonitorScope.description: Workspace-card monitor scope; inactive in flat layout.

ui.label: Cards include
ui.help: Workspace-card monitor scope; inactive in flat layout.

workspaceMonitorOrder.description: Case-sensitive connector order for grouped/all monitor sections. Empty means automatic physical x/y order; disconnected names remain saved for reconnect.

ui.label: Automatic monitor order
ui.help: Case-sensitive connector order for grouped/all monitor sections. Empty means automatic physical x/y order; disconnected names remain saved for reconnect.

groupWindows.description: Deprecated stored compatibility value. It no longer changes presentation; use workspaceGroups or the local Group Windows action. New attempts to enable global grouping are rejected.

ui.label: Not shown
ui.help: Deprecated stored compatibility value. It no longer changes presentation; use workspaceGroups or the local Group Windows action. New attempts to enable global grouping are rejected.

workspaceGroups.description: Opt-in application/workspace group pairs using canonical desktop IDs and id:N or name:N workspace identities.

ui.label: Grouped apps
ui.help: Opt-in application/workspace group pairs using canonical desktop IDs and id:N or name:N workspace identities.

interfaceAnimationsEnabled.description: Enable interface transitions; separate from urgent-window attention motion.

ui.label: Interface animations
ui.help: Enable interface transitions; separate from urgent-window attention motion.

windowScope.description: Running-window scope, independent of pinned launchers and hidden applications.

ui.label: Show windows from
ui.help: Running-window scope, independent of pinned launchers and hidden applications.

showUrgentOutsideScope.description: Allow genuinely urgent windows outside the selected scope; hidden applications remain hidden.

ui.label: Always show urgent windows
ui.help: Allow genuinely urgent windows outside the selected scope; hidden applications remain hidden.

attentionBadgesEnabled.description: Enable attention indicators without starting a notification daemon.

ui.label: Attention badges
ui.help: Enable attention indicators without starting a notification daemon.

urgentWindowAnimationEnabled.description: Enable the existing urgent-window attention motion.

ui.label: Urgent nudge
ui.help: Enable the existing urgent-window attention motion.

launcherBadgeMode.description: Use available provider counts or existing dot fallback; does not install or start a provider.

ui.label: Badge style
ui.help: Use available provider counts or existing dot fallback; does not install or start a provider.

browserProfileBadgesEnabled.description: Show per-window browser profile badges when the browser-profile provider is installed and the browser exposes a DevTools endpoint; no provider is installed or started by this setting.

ui.label: Profile badges
ui.help: Show per-window browser profile badges when the browser-profile provider is installed and the browser exposes a DevTools endpoint; no provider is installed or started by this setting.

dockHerdrIndicators.description: Show Herdr agent state on terminal icons, in hover previews and in the context menu. Uses the existing Herdr provider; enabling it starts that provider while a classic dock is active, including when it is auto-hidden.

ui.label: Agent state on terminal icons
ui.help: Show Herdr agent state on terminal icons, in hover previews and in the context menu. Uses the existing Herdr provider; enabling it starts that provider while a classic dock is active, including when it is auto-hidden.

dockT3Indicators.description: Show T3 Code thread state on the T3 Code icon, in hover previews and in the context menu. Pair with dockrail t3 pair; requires a classic dock to run for dock-only demand.

ui.label: T3 Code threads on dock icons
ui.help: Show paired local T3 Code thread state on its dock icon. Pair with dockrail t3 pair. The sidebar widget has its own activation setting.

dockClaudeIndicators.description: Show Claude Desktop session state on the Claude Desktop dock icon and in its sidebar window row: a working spinner while a session runs, plus input-needed and done marks. The sidebar row also lists one row per session that needs attention. Install the Claude Code hooks with dockrail claude hooks install.

ui.label: Claude Desktop session indicators
ui.help: Show a working spinner on the Claude Desktop dock icon and sidebar window row while one of its Claude Code sessions runs. The sidebar lists each session that needs attention. Install the hooks once with dockrail claude hooks install.

browserActivityMutedServices.description: Muted Chrome activity service IDs (for example gmail or whatsapp). Muted rows stay visible but are excluded from the popup header and dock badge totals. Retained by preference reset.

ui.label: Muted unread services
ui.help: Muted Chrome activity service IDs (for example gmail or whatsapp). Muted rows stay visible but are excluded from the popup header and dock badge totals. Retained by preference reset.

hiddenApplications.description: Hidden desktop IDs; independent of pins. Retained by preference reset.

ui.label: Hidden apps
ui.help: Hidden desktop IDs; independent of pins. Retained by preference reset.

pinned.description: Ordered desktop IDs, including unavailable/hidden apps. Retained by preference reset.

ui.label: Pinned apps
ui.help: Ordered desktop IDs, including unavailable/hidden apps. Retained by preference reset.
